title: Managed Backup: claim window
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines claim window.

## Tier basis

**Outage claim filing period.** Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Outage claim filing period |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 30 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, outage claim filing period is 30.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, outage claim filing period stays the same.
